title: How can women improve pelvic floor health?
subtitle: Evidence-based answer to the common question: how can women improve pelvic floor health?
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports pelvic floor exercises and physiotherapy for improving muscle strength and mild to moderate pelvic floor dysfunction. Emerging evidence suggests lifestyle modifications contribute positively. Some areas, including management of severe prolapse or mixed dysfunction, require individualized approaches and further research.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
